How do I get to Joker Tattoo in Patong?
Contact us before your visit and we will send you the studio location and the clearest directions from where you are staying in Patong or elsewhere in Phuket.
Do I need to book an appointment or can I walk in?
Appointments are recommended so we can give your idea the right artist, preparation and time. Walk-in availability varies, so contacting the studio first is always the best starting point.
How should I prepare before getting a tattoo?

Arrive well rested, hydrated and having eaten a proper meal. Avoid alcohol before your appointment, wear comfortable clothing that gives easy access to the placement, and follow any project-specific guidance from your artist.
What is the recommended tattoo aftercare?

Your artist will provide clear aftercare instructions suited to your tattoo and skin. Follow those directions carefully, keep the area clean, and contact the studio if anything about the healing process is unclear.
What is the difference between Machine and Bamboo Tattoos?

Machine tattooing uses an electric tattoo machine for precise, consistent lining, shading and colour work. Bamboo tattooing is applied by hand with a traditional tool and offers a different rhythm and finish. The best method depends on your design, placement and preferred result, and our artists can guide you.
How much does a tattoo cost?
Pricing depends on the size, placement, level of detail, style and time required. Share your idea with us and a consultation will allow the studio to provide a useful estimate before you book.
